The collaboration is expected to deliver seven films as part of the entertainment offerings lined up for the festive period. The project brings together Oboli’s filmmaking experience and MTN’s entertainment platform, with the movies expected to provide audiences with fresh content during the Christmas holidays. Oboli, who has featured in and produced several Nollywood films, is known for projects including Wives on Strike, The Uprising: Wives on Strike 3 and Love Is War. Further details about the titles, cast members, release dates and platforms for the seven movies were not immediately available.
